## Description {#details}

Struct template representing a floating point value with precision control.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The floating point type to be encapsulated.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code>value</code> struct template specialisation for floating point types encapsulates a value of type <code>T</code> and provides an associated <code>epsilon</code> for precision control during comparisons. It inherits from <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/op">type&#95;traits::op</Link></code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the value via a member variable, a getter method, and an explicit conversion operator. The <code>epsilon</code> member defines the precision used for floating point comparisons and can be set explicitly or computed as a default based on the number of decimal digits in the value.

This specialisation is intended for use cases where floating point values require controlled precision, supporting advanced template metaprogramming and type-safe comparisons within the framework.
